title: BoltOdds: a feed has been silent for 20 min
body: feed bolt silent for 4 scans: BoltOdds: the lines socket is not connected (BoltOdds refused the connection: Too many con. BoltOdds's own check passes and its other feeds answer, so the key and the account are fine. The provider allows only a few connections at once and has refused this one: something else is holding them (an old engine job's sockets that did not close, the phone app, or another tool using the same key). The engine retries by itself with a growing wait and recovers the moment a connection frees up; nothing was switched off and nothing needs doing unless it lasts for hours.
